method: spawn mcp.mjs, send one initialize request, measure spawn-to-response; vary the cache file %TEMP%/local-agent-chat-display-language.json

measurements.note: cache file became zh-CN about 2 s later

note: The value still comes from PowerShell (Get-WinUILanguageOverride, else Get-UICulture); Intl is only used on non-Windows. Cache is written atomically (temp + rename) with mode 0600, refreshed in the background after 1 hour, re-detected synchronously after 24 hours. A language change therefore appears on the next connection once the cache has been refreshed (within about an hour), or immediately after deleting the cache file.
